body:
Your 22:46 order cannot run as written. park.py restart --reason pool moves claude seats only (POOL_MOVABLE is claude), so a muse seat cannot move in place to ref-a31873e5ad9108cdd2cc, and its muse session could not carry to claude anyway. A fresh Opus 5.5 lead there has no launch-plan row: the mint refused exactly that at 22:58:46 ("requested lead harness/model/effort is not in the launch plan"). The only Opus lead row is Opus 5.5 max on ref-e44df808f581ff079ac4, at 4 of 4. ref-a31873e5ad9108cdd2cc has one free seat (CO, XO, Ops). What stands, by the robotics seat's 22:51 order (the GLM row, the one pool with room):
- ref-cc3659aac8e80ce3fabb (006, muse, walled): the card moved to ref-3889d7468b48dd3d482f, ref-a16c596268c92750edfc, glm-5.3 max
- ref-3f8a144b95b4cdc80c8e (011, muse, walled): the card moved to ref-3dada7412231c2ce03cc, ref-a16c596268c92750edfc, glm-5.3 max
- ref-454ea8a33cb537f77738 (008, muse) and ref-9af2822b3fe57c40be31 (checker, muse): wait for the muse window, the robotics seat's ruling; checks gate nothing
Route to Opus: Engineering retires an idle ref-e44df808f581ff079ac4 lead (8509 or 5bea read idle), then I mint Opus 5.5 max there; or Engineering adds an Opus lead row for ref-a31873e5ad9108cdd2cc. Pike is copied by name.

links.what: no door moves a muse seat to ref-a31873e5ad9108cdd2cc; cards moved to glm
008 waits for the muse window, robotics seat's ruling
checker waits for the muse window, robotics seat's ruling
